## Working session summary

I've fixed the workflow in PR #6 (https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/pull/6), but the site itself can't be checked until the PR is merged into `main`. Only `main` is allowed to deploy to Pages, so this branch can't publish anything.

**Why the site is empty.** Pages is set to deploy from GitHub Actions (the Pages API reports `"build_type": "workflow"`). In that mode Pages only publishes what a workflow hands to `actions/deploy-pages`. The `deploy` job never did that: it copied the build into `docs/` and pushed a commit, which only works when Pages is set to deploy from a branch folder. The run was green, but the build ended up in the repository, not on the site. What's live is the only deployment ever made: GitHub's automatic build of `docs/` at `3d4aa8d`, from before the setting was switched. At that commit `docs/` held only `case-studies/`, so `/` returns 404 and `/case-studies/issue-1/` returns 200.

**What changed:**
- **Upload:** after the build, the `test` job uploads `build/` with `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5`. Pull requests do this too, so a broken upload fails before merge.
- **Deploy:** on `main`, the `deploy` job publishes that same tested build with `actions/deploy-pages@v5`. It no longer commits to the repository, so it no longer needs write access to the code.
- **Live check:** a new `scripts/check-deployed-site.sh` runs right after the deploy. It fails the run unless the site serves the React page and its main script loads, so an empty site can't show up as a green run again.
- **`docs/`:** I removed the old build files, which were never deployed and only looked like they were. Only `docs/case-studies` is left.
- **Tests and docs:** new workflow tests in `src/workflow.test.js`, plus updates to the README and comments. The analysis and saved evidence (Pages API output, CI logs, deployments) are in `dev/log/issues/5/pulls/6/`.

**Checks run:**
- The new tests fail 5 times against the old workflow; with the fix all 38 pass.
- Locally, lint, formatting, file size, secret scan, build, `npm audit` (0 vulnerabilities) and actionlint all pass. shellcheck isn't installed here, so CI's actionlint will be the first to run it on the new script.
- The check script accepts a locally served build and rejects a server that has only `docs/`. Against the live site it fails with 404, as expected.
- CI run 39035273727 is green with no warnings, and the deploy job was skipped on the PR as intended. I downloaded its Pages upload and it contains the full app.

**One side effect:** `/case-studies/issue-1/` will stop being served after the merge. It only appeared because the app was missing. The case study is still readable in the repository.

The PR is marked ready. In its requirements report, "the site actually serves the app" is marked blocked until the merge. When it's merged, the "Verify the deployed site" step will confirm https://konard.github.io works, or fail that run if it doesn't.
